tellings.difference: This telling credits nobody, while the story's telling credits Paola Harris and Robert Oppenheimer; it also says only "UFO custody" from the 1940s on, without naming the Trinity craft or the year 1945.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Jacques Vallee's account of the custody chain from the Manhattan Project to the AEC to the DOE's own clearance system, in almost the same words. The "it" in the telling is the craft the story names as the Trinity craft.

as_told.title: UFO custody passed from Manhattan Project to AEC to Department of Energy clearance system

plain: A longtime UFO researcher named Jacques Vallee, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast more than once, describes how a crashed craft linked to 1945 and Trinity, the site of the first atomic bomb test, would have been held. He says the Manhattan Project, the wartime effort that built the bomb, would have had custody of it first, then the Atomic Energy Commission, and then the Department of Energy, which has its own separate security clearances. If true, it would explain why the object stayed hidden in the nuclear world, outside the military's usual channels.
